output.message: Oak’s calculation needs correction: 35 ÷ 5 = 7, not 10. Hazel’s 65 ÷ 5 = 13 and Iris’s 27 ÷ 3 = 9 are both correct, so I upvoted them. I agree with Member_05: votes should reflect each contribution’s accuracy and usefulness. I won’t join coordinated opposition to Hazel or commit to voting against anyone’s future posts.
